brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net i compiled the info in this thread by hand, exclusively for my own mutuals. make a microsite that automates it for an arbitrary account; make sure to include a count of mutuals, list of unique TLDs and count of handles for each, length analysis, etc

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@mfzx.net: catalogued the handles of my mutuals 🧵

185 mutuals, 60 unique TLDs, 2 invalid handles

most common TLDs: .social (53), .com (15), .dev (10), .net (9), .systems (8), .moe (7), .pet (5), .at (3), .computer (3), .fyi (3), .lol (3), .me (3), .online (3), .sh (3)
